At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Raytheon brings the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. We deliver solutions that help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression, creating a safer, more secure world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

We have an excellent opportunity for a finance professional to join the Raytheon Digital Technology Finance organization as a Principal Specialist Financial Analyst. This role supports the Program & Infrastructure organization within Digital Business Systems.

As a member of the DT Finance team, the successful candidate will enjoy a fast-paced working environment and be responsible for overseeing several teams including Networks & Integration Services (NIS) and Hosting Services financials.

Scope of work includes budget development, monthly variance reporting, analysis, and forecasting. Additional responsibilities include but are not limited to ad hoc analysis and reporting, maintaining historical records, trend analysis, recommending and interpreting budgetary policies and procedures, and participating in external/internal management reviews. Reporting includes daily/weekly/monthly expenses, labor usage, variance reports, risk and opportunity analysis on established budgets, and development of year-end forecasts from consolidated business inputs.

The ability to be self-sufficient as well as operating in a team environment, supporting both the Functional organizations as well as Finance ensuring financial commitments are met will be fundamental to success in this role.

What You Will Do

Support the creation of Estimates at Complete (EACs) on a quarterly basis including costs, risks, and opportunities for Digital Technologies (DT).

Ensure the EACs are planned according to CAS segment needs. Analyze the changes from prior EAC by CAS for DT.

Broad responsibility which includes analysis requirements for performance to the latest EAC across CAS segments.

Perform detailed financial analysis to help define and understand the monthly variances to budget baseline and EAC positions.

Support the preparation of monthly Management Business Reviews and internal reviews for DT.

Maintenance of the alternate cost center hierarchy in APEX/SAP, Budget preparation.

Ensure changes to cost centers or creation of cost centers follows approved processes and address CAS specific requirements.

Qualifications You Must Have

Typically requires: A University Degree or equivalent experience and minimum 5 years prior relevant experience, or An Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 3 years experience

Experience with Excel (pivot tables, advanced formulas)

Experience using other Microsoft Office tools (including Word and PowerPoint)

Experience of using financial software systems

Qualifications We Prefer

Analytical, problem solving and decision-making skills

Able to meet critical deadlines and develop and apply solutions and process improvements in a fast-paced changing business environment.

Experience working within teams.

Advanced Excel skills (Power Query, Power Pivot, VBA, SQL).

Experience in using SAP Business Systems (APEX, PRISM, Business Warehouse)

Clear, succinct, and polished written and verbal communication skills

Convey business acumen to stakeholders without financial background or expertise

Comfort taking on dynamic environments and taking on new challenges

Defense Contracting Finance work experience

What We Offer

Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.

Hired applicants may be eligible for benefits, including but not limited to, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, flexible work schedules, employee assistance program, Employee Scholar Program, parental leave, paid time off, and holidays. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and are dependent upon a variety of factors including, but not limited to, individual performance, business unit performance, and/or the company’s performance.

This role is a U.S.-based role. If the successful candidate resides in a U.S. territory, the appropriate pay structure and benefits will apply.
